summary: Iteration 3 testing complete. All 3 new features working: 1) Email validator with domain typo suggestions (gmial→gmail, yaho→yahoo, hotmal→hotmail), 2) A2P-compliant SMS consent checkbox with proper TCPA verbiage, 3) Phone field is optional. Backend 19/19 tests pass (100%), Frontend all features verified.
critical_code_review_comments: Email validator correctly catches common domain misspellings and offers clickable corrections
SMS consent checkbox only appears when phone is entered (conditional rendering working)
A2P verbiage includes all TCPA-compliant elements: company name, msg frequency, data rates, STOP, HELP, not condition of purchase
Phone field marked as optional in mock.js and correctly has no asterisk in form
Backend stores smsConsent boolean and smsConsentTimestamp correctly
Admin dashboard shows 'SMS opted in' status for leads with consent
Mobile layout (375px) does not overflow - SMS consent section fits properly
seed_data_creation: Created test consultations with/without phone, with/without SMS consent during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 3 features tested and working: (1) Email validation catches gmial.com→gmail.com, yaho.com→yahoo.com, hotmal.com→hotmail.com with clickable 'Did you mean?' suggestion, (2) SMS consent checkbox appears only when phone entered, unchecked by default, has full A2P verbiage, (3) Phone field is optional - no asterisk, form submits without it. Backend accepts smsConsent=true/false with timestamp. Admin dashboard shows 'SMS opted in' label for leads with consent. Mobile layout (375px) works without overflow. 15 consultation leads, 2 paid, 13 pending, 8 callbacks in system.
